reference_transcript: Alright, Pull Day. Deadlift, um, one hundred and forty kilos for five reps. Bent-over barbell row, sixty kilos, three sets, ten reps each. Lat pulldown, uh, fifty five for twelve, sixty for ten, sixty five for eight. Assisted pull-up, um, twenty kilos assistance, eight reps, two sets. And, uh, barbell curl, thirty kilos for twelve reps, one set.

meta.notes: 'one hundred and forty' multi-word number; pyramid weights on lat pulldown (55/60/65, all close together — stresses whether sets get merged/dropped); assistance load_mode where a BIGGER number means an EASIER set — must not be treated like normal external load; 'thirty' (barbell curl) is a classic thirteen/thirty confusion risk
